title: Tiny, cute skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- deck -->
  <rect x='10' y='40' width='80' height='14' rx='7' fill='#ff6b35'/>
  <!-- deck light stripe -->
  <rect x='12' y='41' width='76' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffaa66'/>
  <!-- nose curve highlight -->
  <path d='M12 47 Q8 47 10 40' stroke='#ffaa66' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 47 Q92 47 90 40' stroke='#ffaa66' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- grip tape dots -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#cc4400'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#cc4400'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#cc4400'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#cc4400'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#cc4400'/>
  <!-- trucks -->
  <rect x='25' y='54' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b0b0c0'/>
  <rect x='59' y='54' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b0b0c0'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='64' r='7' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#ffaa00'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='64' r='7' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#ffaa00'/>
  <!-- wheel shine -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='62' r='2' fill='#fff8cc'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='62' r='2' fill='#fff8cc'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d='M50 25 L52 32 L59 34 L52 36 L50 43 L48 36 L41 34 L48 32 Z' fill='#66ddff'/>
</svg>
